info.title: BetterToken API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API endpoints through BetterToken.

post.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with GPT Image 2. Send an application/json request. The successful response contains the image in data[0].b64_json.

model.description: Use the GPT Image 2 model ID.

prompt.description: A detailed description of the image to generate.
prompt.example: A futuristic AI product poster on a light background, with glass textures, a clean composition, and a premium technology aesthetic.

n.description: Use 1. Send separate requests when you need multiple output images.

size.description: The requested image size or aspect-ratio tier. The server may map or adjust the final pixel dimensions, so inspect the decoded image for its actual size.

output_format.description: Use png. Do not rely on jpeg or webp being returned directly in the selected format.

example.prompt: A futuristic AI product poster on a light background, with glass textures, a clean composition, and a premium technology aesthetic.

401.description: The BetterToken API Key is missing or invalid.

402.description: The account has insufficient credit or balance.

429.description: The request exceeded a rate or concurrency limit, or the upstream service is busy.

500.description: The gateway or upstream service returned an error.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl 'https://bettertoken.ai/v1/images/generations' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2",
    "prompt": "A futuristic AI product poster on a light background, with glass textures, a clean composition, and a premium technology aesthetic.",
    "n": 1,
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "response_format": "b64_json",
    "output_format": "png"
  }'

post.description: Create a new image from one or more reference images with GPT Image 2. You can also guide a local edit with an optional mask. Send the request as multipart/form-data. The successful response contains the image in data[0].b64_json.

model.description: Use the GPT Image 2 model ID.

prompt.description: Instructions for editing the image or generating from reference images.
prompt.example: Use this reference image to create a more polished square product hero image while preserving the main style.

image.description: The reference image field for a single input image.

image[].description: Repeat this field for each input when sending multiple reference images.

mask.description: An optional single mask file. The mask and original image must have the same format and dimensions, each file must be smaller than 50 MB, and the mask must contain an Alpha channel. For maximum compatibility, use PNG with an Alpha channel for both files. With multiple image[] inputs, the mask applies to the first image.

n.description: Use 1. Send separate requests when you need multiple output images.

size.description: The requested image size or aspect-ratio tier. The server may map or adjust the final pixel dimensions, so inspect the decoded image for its actual size.

output_format.description: Use png. Do not rely on jpeg or webp being returned directly in the selected format.

example.prompt: Use this reference image to create a more polished square product hero image while preserving the main style.

401.description: The BetterToken API Key is missing or invalid.

402.description: The account has insufficient credit or balance.

429.description: The request exceeded a rate or concurrency limit, or the upstream service is busy.

500.description: The gateway or upstream service returned an error.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL single image
x-codeSamples.source:
curl 'https://bettertoken.ai/v1/images/edits' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -F 'model=gpt-image-2' \
  -F 'prompt=Use this reference image to create a more polished square product hero image while preserving the main style.' \
  -F 'n=1' \
  -F 'size=1024x1024' \
  -F 'response_format=b64_json' \
  -F 'output_format=png' \
  -F 'image=@reference.png'

x-codeSamples.label: cURL multiple images
x-codeSamples.source:
curl 'https://bettertoken.ai/v1/images/edits' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -F 'model=gpt-image-2' \
  -F 'prompt=Combine these reference images into one consistent promotional poster.' \
  -F 'n=1' \
  -F 'size=1024x1024' \
  -F 'response_format=b64_json' \
  -F 'output_format=png' \
  -F 'image[]=@reference-1.png' \
  -F 'image[]=@reference-2.jpg' \
  -F 'image[]=@reference-3.png'

x-codeSamples.label: cURL masked edit
x-codeSamples.source:
curl 'https://bettertoken.ai/v1/images/edits' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -F 'model=gpt-image-2' \
  -F 'prompt=Replace only the masked area with a blue circle. Preserve everything else.' \
  -F 'n=1' \
  -F 'size=1024x1024' \
  -F 'response_format=b64_json' \
  -F 'output_format=png' \
  -F 'image=@original.png' \
  -F 'mask=@mask.png'
